correctness.rationale: The 26 vertices split as 13 projective points and 13 pairwise adjacent projective lines, with incidence matrix B satisfying BB^T=B^TB=3I+J. Symmetric graph-pattern matrix [I B;B^T B^TB] has rank13 and yields M>=13; a 13-vertex seed with explicit 13 legal forcing moves gives Z<=13. Independent separate complete enumeration of all 67,108,864 masks exactly reproduced all polynomial coefficients and orbit BFS produced 254 PGL(3,3) orbits and stated histogram. Found and corrected ancillary false assertion in source RESULT.md: coefficients sum to 19,399,940 forcing sets, NOT to 2^26; remaining 47,708,924 are nonforcing. Final corrected RESULT supplied in full.
